mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_intellectual_property (ip_id, tenant_id, spu_id, type, name, registration_no, jurisdiction, status, filed_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ipId}, #{tenantId}, #{spuId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{registrationNo}, #{jurisdiction}, #{status}, #{filedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pdm_intellectual_property SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE ip_id = #{ipId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT ip_id, tenant_id, spu_id, type, name, registration_no, jurisdiction, status, filed_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pdm_intellectual_property WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ip_id = #{ipId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_quality_standard (standard_id, tenant_id, category_id, name, description, inspection_items, acceptance_criteria, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{standardId}, #{tenantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{inspectionItems}, #{acceptanceCriteria}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT standard_id, tenant_id, category_id, name, description, inspection_items, acceptance_criteria, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM pdm_quality_standard WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND standard_id = #{standardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_product_variant (variant_id, tenant_id, spu_id, variant_name, variant_attributes, purchase_cost, selling_price, price_adjustment, seller_sku, images, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{variantId}, #{tenantId}, #{spuId}, #{variantName}, #{variantAttributes}, #{purchaseCost}, #{sellingPrice}, #{priceAdjustment}, #{sellerSku}, #{images}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT variant_id, tenant_id, spu_id, variant_name, variant_attributes, purchase_cost, selling_price, price_adjustment, seller_sku, images, status, created_at, updated_at FROM pdm_product_variant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND spu_id = #{spuId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_product_collection (collection_id, tenant_id, source_platform, source_url, product_name, description, images, price, currency, category_id, collected_by, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{collectionId}, #{tenantId}, #{sourcePlatform}, #{sourceUrl}, #{productName}, #{description}, #{images}, #{price}, #{currency}, #{categoryId}, #{collectedBy}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT collection_id, tenant_id, source_platform, source_url, product_name, description, images, price, currency, category_id, collected_by, status, created_at, updated_at FROM pdm_product_collection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT collection_id, tenant_id, source_platform, source_url, product_name, description, images, price, currency, category_id, collected_by, status, created_at, updated_at FROM pdm_product_collection WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
